brainlife.desc: Quantitative MRI maps (NIfTI) such as T1, R1, M0, PD, MTV, T2* and R2*, each optional, with JSON sidecars for some.
brainlife.name: neuro/anat/qmri

file_descs.M0map: In general, this is for output only. For App, please assume this files to not exist and compute it from T1map and pd
file_descs.MTV: macromolecular tissue volume. In general, this is for output only. For App, please assume this files to not exist and compute it from T1map and pd
file_descs.R1map: In general, this is for output only. For App, please assume this files to not exist and compute it by intervening T1map
file_descs.R2star: Voxels represent the calculated effective transverse relaxation time T2* in seconds. T2* is shorter than T2 because it incorporates additional dephasing from magnetic field inhomogeneities.
file_descs.SIR: surface interaction rate. In general, this is for output only. For App, please assume this files to not exist and compute it from T1map and pd
file_descs.T2star: The inverse of T2* (1/T2*) in s^-1.
file_descs.VIP: volume of interacting water proton. In general, this is for output only. For App, please assume this files to not exist and compute it from T1map and pd
file_descs.WF: Water fraction. In general, this is for output only. For App, please assume this files to not exist and compute it from T1map and pd

original.readme:
https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/99-appendices/11-qmri.html

Quantitative MRI (qMRI) is a collection of methods aiming at generating parametric maps that can characterize underlying tissue properties. Unlike those of conventional MR images (for example, T1w or T2w), intensity values of quantitative maps are not represented in an arbitrary range. Instead, these maps are represented either in absolute physical units (for example, seconds for T1map), or within an application dependent range of arbitrary units (for example, myelin water fraction MWFmap in brain).
